title: From Tech NAM to NAS: India’s case for tech sovereignty through strategic choices
description: It is crucial for countries to embrace a non-aligned sovereignty approach in artificial intelligence, enabling them to diversify their technological alliances and systems. Brazil's proactive AI investment strategy sets a strong example by collaborating with multiple global partners. India’s foreign policy reflects this multi-alignment ethos, crucial for its AI initiatives. To secure autonomy, nations need to oversee critical infrastructures while keeping alternative options available.
